items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: I did an arrangement for Larry Harlow called the “Rumbambola.”

ctx.x: Well you know a cha-cha, when you say rumba, a rumba is actually a very fast number. But in the American market a rumba was just sort of like a little uptempo cha-cha. But it’s not really a cha-cha, it’s not really a rumba. Actually see rumba is a — almost like a jam session but a fast rhythm. I did an arrangement, maybe that was even too fast, but I did an arrangement for Larry Harlow called the “Rumbambola.” That was taken from a piece that a famous Latin pianist whose name escapes me now, sorry, had recorded.…
I recall a dance instructor said, “You need to play more cha-chas like “Billie Jean.”
